nodes.name: BUILD_AND_PUSH.md
nodes.summary: Mandatory release checklist for building and pushing Docker images — covers the automated release script, manual pre-release steps, version bumping, Docker build/push, git tagging, and troubleshooting common release issues. CLAUDE.md requires this document be followed exactly for any deployment request.

nodes.name: DEBUGGING_AND_OPTIMIZATION.md
nodes.summary: Quick-reference guide for when and how to invoke the Debugger and Code Optimizer subagents, including common debugging tips (validation/type errors, stale data) and optimization principles (Rule of Three).

nodes.name: DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOWS.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step workflow guide covering how to add a new full-stack feature, work with UI components, make database changes, and implement authentication, entity linking, timeline/printable itinerary, album pagination, checklists, trip health check, backup/restore, trip collaboration, global search, batch operations, and auto-save drafts.

nodes.name: HTTPS_SETUP.md
nodes.summary: Guide for enabling HTTPS/TLS in production via an Nginx reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt or via Traefik, plus cookie-security settings and setup verification steps.

nodes.name: ROUTING_SETUP.md
nodes.summary: Setup guide for the OpenRouteService integration that enables accurate road-distance calculations, covering API key configuration for dev/production/TrueNAS, routing profiles, caching, straight-line fallback behavior, troubleshooting, and self-hosting.

nodes.name: TESTING_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Testing strategy and setup guide covering Vitest frontend tests, Jest backend tests, and Playwright/Cypress E2E tests, with example test code, coverage goals, and CI/CD integration notes.
